show.description: A street-smart Jaipur Uber driver Prakriti and gentle empire heir Akshay Middha can’t stand each other, until a forced contract marriage slowly turns dislike into love, and boardroom conspiracies, jealous Suhani, and drug-running cousin Tanmay turn their fake vows into a deadly war for power and the heart.
